      "id": "c:5234820518",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "-walletnotify is invoked a second time for unchanged transactions during full second scan passes",
      "quote": "The second walk also re-runs -walletnotify. AddToWallet notifies on every call, so the script fires again for transactions that did not change",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "accepted the prefix-bounded re-scan in commit 278564b",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5262264789"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5264417632",
      "status_by_quote": "ACK 278564b95c0607fd54892d42a60a001e6b32a236"
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5041935034",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "If a child tx spends a lookahead parent later in the block, prefix rescan misses the child and leaves the parent output classified as unspent",
      "quote": "The parent output can remain classified as unspent, leaving the wallet balance incorrect until another rescan.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "fixed by replacing shrinking-prefix rescan with retry-until-stable loop covering same-block child spends (Part 6)",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5457594935",
        "c:6029266088"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6029266088",
      "status_by_quote": "a same-block spend of a look-ahead receive only recognized later in the same pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3872661031",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Avoid calling collect_range_ends() when SyncTransaction() returns false",
      "quote": "We can avoid some calls to collect_range_ends() by checking the return value of SyncTransaction().",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "implemented in 1d9de0e6",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5457638606",
        "rc:3883805239"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3883892813",
      "status_by_quote": "Done."

      "id": "rc:3872753832",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Use std::move when assigning cur to range_ends",
      "quote": "range_ends = std::move(cur);",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "implemented in 1d9de0e6",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5457638606",
        "rc:3883736747"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3883892059",
      "status_by_quote": "Done."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3872872400",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Combine the initial scan and prefix rescans into a single loop using scan_end as the bound",
      "quote": "The initial full-block scan and the subsequent prefix rescans can be combined by using scan_end as the exclusive upper bound",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "consolidated into a single loop in 1d9de0e6",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5457638606",
        "rc:3883858331",
        "rc:3883893881"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3883893881",
      "status_by_quote": "Done, thanks!"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5459727026",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "A cascading receive past scan_end that becomes wallet-relevant only after the prefix pass recovers an earlier tx is missed, leaving the wallet balance short",
      "quote": "A receive only becomes the wallet's once the prefix pass recovers an earlier one, and it sits past scan_end. The balance comes out 0.00050000 short.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "fixed by replacing prefix rescan with retry-until-stable loop (Part 5)",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6029266088"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6029266088",
      "status_by_quote": "a prefix-recovered receive triggering a further pool expansion past where the prefix had already shrunk to;"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6019329096",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Why only rescan the block prefix rather than entire or multiple previous blocks, and what is the accepted performance-loss metric?",
      "quote": "This PR proposes the prefix of the block, why not 1 entire block? Why not N previous blocks? Which is the accepted performance-loss metric?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied in detail explaining the full-block retry loop and performance characteristics",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6028767336"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6028767336",
      "status_by_quote": "The PR description needs updating — the current approach goes through the entire block, not a prefix."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4204587783",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Check for shutdown and abort requests between passes in the retry loop",
      "quote": "Since you’re changing this code and the loop now retries transactions, you could also check for shutdown and abort requests between passes.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "implemented and tested in commit pushed with c:6044809901",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4209523577",
        "c:6044809901",
        "rc:4210830393"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4210830393",
      "status_by_quote": "Done."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4466941133",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Change ScanBlock to return std::optional<bool> returning std::nullopt on cancellation to avoid repeating abort/shutdown checks at the call site",
      "quote": "You can change `ScanBlock` to return `std::optional<bool>` and return `std::nullopt` here to indicate cancellation",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4523912635",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Is part 3 of the functional test still necessary given that parts 1 and 2 already cover it?",
      "quote": "Is part 3 still necessary? With the fix applied, part 3 doesn't test anything that parts 1 and 2 don't already cover.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4523973699",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Is there still a 'prefix pass' in the code, or do the comments refer to a previous approach?",
      "quote": "Is there a \"prefix pass\" in the code? The comments about \"prefix pass\" are a bit confusing.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4524585905",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "The benchmark's TopUp derivation costs dominate scan time and hide the retry cost, preventing comparison with pre-fix code",
      "quote": "the cost of these TopUps will dominate the scan time and hide the retry cost. It also doesn't allow comparison with the pre-fix code",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
